articles.title: Preview: Panthers battle defending champion Hurricanes in season opener
Panthers look like contenders again in impressive opening win
Panthers look like contenders again in impressive opening win
Markstrom blanks Hurricanes in first start for Panthers since 2014
Celebrini, Bedard not too young to captain Sharks, Blackhawks

away.summary: The Florida Panthers are coming off an impressive 1-0 overtime win against the Carolina Hurricanes in their season opener, with Jacob Markstrom delivering a 15-save shutout. Aleksander Barkov returned from a major knee injury, and Brady Tkachuk made his Panthers debut. The team is looking strong with a solid lineup and key returning players, though they are missing some key forwards due to injury.

home.summary: The San Jose Sharks are set to face the Florida Panthers in their season opener, with Yaroslav Askarov projected to start in goal. The Sharks have a few scratches for their projected lineup, but no major injuries or doubtful players. The team is looking to build on their young talent, with Macklin Celebrini making his NHL debut as captain.
